candidates.specificOwnerTechnique: Set seated trainer facing the actual high-pulley station; hands overhead gripping the bar in front of face. Pull toward upper chest (never behind neck), elbows down/back, chest lifted and torso almost stationary; control return. Three-quarter front/side camera must show the machine, face, full cast support, arms and bar. If machine pads would press on the injured left leg, position the leg free of pads and support it independently; do not show otherwise physically impossible machine access.
